card.name: Space before a dose number
card.fires_on: The space right before a dose amount or interval number, such as after 'every' or 'exceed' in dosing sentences. It also fires on a few spots inside drug names like rizatriptan or QULIPTA.

modes.label: Space before number
modes.description: A blank space just before a dose, interval or limit number in dosing directions.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Partway through a triptan or similar drug name.

card.writes: It suppresses time-of-day words like evening and before, so it steers away from bedtime or evening timing after the dose.
card.plain: It fires on the gap just before a dose number or interval in dosing instructions.
